an7.74:1.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave Arako nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
an7.74:1.2: Arakassa kho pana bhikkhave satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
an7.74:1.3: Arako satthā sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desesi:-- 2.
an7.74:1.4: Appakaṃ brāhmaṇa jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:2.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa tiṇagge ussāvabindu suriye uggacchante khippaṃ yeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an7.74:2.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa ussāvabindūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:3.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakabubbulaṃ khippaṃ yeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an7.74:3.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa udakabubbulūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
an7.74:4.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa udake daṇḍarāji khippaṃ yeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an7.74:4.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa udake daṇḍarājūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ . . .
an7.74:5.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa nadi pabbateyyā dūraṅgamā sīghasotā hārahārinī, natthi so khaṇo vā layo vā muhutto vā, yaṃ sā āramati, atha kho sā gacchat' eva vattat' eva sandat' eva, evam
an7.74:5.2: eva kho brāhmaṇa nadipabbateyyūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ . . . pe . . .
an7.74:6.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa balavā puriso jivhagge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saññūhitvā appakasiren' eva vameyya,
an7.74:6.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa kheḷapiṇḍūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ . . .
an7.74:7.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa divasasantatte ayokaṭāhe maṃsapesī pakkhittā khippaṃ yeva paṭivigacchati na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti,
an7.74:7.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa maṃsapesūpamaṃ manussānaṃ jīvitaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ . . .
an7.74:8.1: Seyyathā pi brāhmaṇa gāvī vajjhā āghātanaṃ niyyamānā yañ ñad eva pādaṃ uddharati santike 'va hoti vadhassa santike 'va maraṇassa,
an7.74:8.2: evam eva kho brāhmaṇa govajjhūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan ti. 3.
an7.74:9.1: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. Pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā ahosi.
an7.74:9.2: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ chaḷ eva ābādhā ahesum:
an7.74:9.3: sītaṃ uṇhaṃ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo.
an7.74:9.4: So hi nāma bhikkhave Arako satthā evaṃ dīghāyukesu manussesu evaṃ ciraṭṭhitikesu evaṃ appābādhesu sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desessati
an7.74:9.5: ‘appakaṃ brāhmaṇa jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan' ti.
an7.74:10.1: Etarahi kho taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an7.74:10.2: ‘appakaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahūpāyāsaṃ. Mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan' ti.
an7.74:10.3: Etarahi kho bhikkhave yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
an7.74:10.4: Vassasataṃ kho pana bhikkhave jīvanto tīṇi yeva utusatāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.5: utusataṃ hemantānaṃ, utusataṃ gimhānaṃ, utusataṃ vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.6: Tīṇi kho pana bhikkhave utusatāni jīvanto dvādasa yeva māsasatāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.7: cattāri māsasatāni hemantānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni gimhānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.8: Dvādasa kho pana bhikkhave māsasatāni jīvanto catuvīsatiṃ yeva addhamāsasatāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.9: aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni hemantānaṃ, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni gimhānaṃ, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.10: Catuvīsatiṃ kho pana bhikkhave addhamāsasatāni jīvanto chattiṃsaṃ yeva rattisahassāni jīvati:
an7.74:10.11: dvādasa rattisahassāni hemantānaṃ, dvādasa rattisahassāni gimhānaṃ, dvādasa rattisahassāni vassānaṃ.
an7.74:10.12: Chattiṃsaṃ kho pana bhikkhave rattisahassāni jīvanto dvesattatiñ ñeva bhattasahassāni bhuñjati:
an7.74:10.13: catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni hemantānaṃ, catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni gimhānaṃ, catuvīsatiṃ bhattasahassāni vassānaṃ saddhiṃ mātuthaññāya saddhiṃ bhattantarāyena.
an7.74:11.1: Tatr' ime bhattantarāyā: kupito pi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, dukkhito pi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, vyādhito pi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, uposathiko pi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, alābhakena pi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati.
an7.74:11.2: Iti kho bhikkhave mayā vassasatāyukassa manussassa āyu pi saṃkhāto, āyuppamāṇam pi saṃkhātaṃ,utū pi saṃkhātā, saṃvaccharā pi saṃkhātā, māsā pi saṃkhātā, addhamāsā pi saṃkhātā, rattī pi saṃkhātā, rattindivā pi saṃkhātā, bhattā pi saṃkhātā, bhattantarāyā pi saṃkhātā. 4.
an7.74:11.3: Yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya,
an7.74:11.4: kataṃ vo taṃ mayā. Etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha bhikkhave, mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī ti.
